tools.name: check_australian_business_day
tools.description: Check whether a date is a business day in an Australian state or territory and return the previous and next business day.

tools.name: calculate_australian_business_date
tools.description: Add or subtract Australian business days from a date for a specified state or territory. Positive numbers move forward and negative numbers move backward. The start date is excluded.

tools.name: count_australian_business_days
tools.description: Count business days between two Australian calendar dates for a specified state or territory. Boundary inclusion is explicit so agents do not have to guess the counting rule.

tools.name: calculate_australian_deadline
tools.description: Calculate an Australian deadline using either calendar days or business days, with an explicit start-date counting rule and optional rolling to the next or previous business day when the calculated date is not a business day.
